0x1002A0C0.name: CYyModelBase_ApplyToPartsAndMarkChains
0x1002A0C0.evidence: clears the marks at self+8 (Skel_ClearMarks); loops over GetPartList calling each part's vtable slot 0x28 with the value at self+0x1C; sets bytes to 0x80 at FindPartIndex(0x7F) and FindPartIndex(0x7E); then Skel_MarkMarkedChains
0x1002A0C0.summary: Applies the model's value at +0x1C to every part, marks two indexed parts, then marks the skeleton's chains.

0x1002A780.name: CYyModelBase_ApplyPartTransformToVec4
0x1002A780.evidence: gets the part record with Skel_GetRecordAt(self+8, id); if non-null builds a 4x4 from rotations X, Y, Z of the record, translation from Part_CopyTranslation, and the bone table entry (Skel_GetBoneTableBase via the *psVar1*0x40 term), then Mat4_TransformVec4InPlace on param_2; returns 0 when the record is missing
0x1002A780.summary: Builds the part's rotation-and-translation matrix from its record and transforms the vector by it.
